feature.label: General SEM simultaneous two-way PLS moderation full-model case bootstrap

implemented_contracts: a distinct deterministic compiler version for the exact interaction_v2 percentile two-sided case-bootstrap request
the existing moderation point cell remains the compiled artifact primary authority while the new moderation bootstrap cell is a supplemental inference authorization
Rust and TypeScript preflight return the point and supplemental cells for simultaneous same-focal and different-focal layouts without mutating the authored model or point decision

each indexed case replicate reruns the shared stage-one PLS model, sign-aligns complete score vectors against sampled original scores before products, recomputes every product scale, refits the complete joint stage-two equations, and validates the full point contract
only one typed stable scientific-rescaled-gamma target per compiled interaction receives Type-7 percentile, B-minus-one standard-error, and null-centered plus-one inference
the exact max(2, ceil(0.9B)) usable gate, ordered typed failures, cancellation, and worker-invariant indexed execution are receipt-bound
canonical gamma-only inference, schema-6 append and strict reopen, and native accessible readback are connected in the existing QuickPLS General SEM workflow
Capability Registry V2 records the exact gamma-only Standard predicate under rank0_streamlined_plan4b_v1

typed compiler and runtime exclusions remain in force for BCa, one-sided tails, probes, requested mediation effects, directed chains, unsupported interaction order, unsupported construction methods, and non-strong hierarchy
blocked_contracts: bootstrap inference for standardized-product coefficients, ordinary joint-stage coefficients, conditional slopes, and plots
BCa, studentized, basic, one-sided, cluster, strata, weighted, parametric, residual, and Bayesian resampling
three-way and higher-order interactions, moderated mediation, directed structural chains, requested indirect or total effects, and authored probe policies
higher-order constructs, groups, weights, non-listwise missing-data handling, transformed observed inputs, and non-continuous observed scales
legacy-project migration or any project without schema 6 and the general_sem_v1 generation marker
remaining_qualification: Standard qualification uses rank0_streamlined_plan4b_v1; package and performance evidence is representative rather than per-cell, and every scientific exclusion in this contract remains in force.
